title: campanula stricta var. alidagensis
intro: Campanula stricta var. alidagensis, commonly known as the Strict Bellflower, is a plant species that belongs to the family Campanulaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, where it is used to treat various health issues such as inflammation, pain, and digestive problems. The Strict Bellflower is known to possess therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Campanula stricta var. alidagensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
